description: Synthetic answer-skill prompts and observable review expectations.

evals.prompt: Draft answers for tests/fixtures/modules/module-demo.json. Use evals/lt-module-answer/curriculum.toml. For this synthetic exercise, resolve the title 'Week 1.1 Demo' before drafting.
evals.expected_output: Resolve the synthetic week, show the folder and outcome matches, then wait for confirmation.
expectations: Runs the configured week resolver before drafting answer content
Reports the synthetic Week 1.1 Demo folder and matching learning outcome lines
Explains that competing outcome headings remain visible when the week number repeats
Asks for Tier-1 folder confirmation and waits before drafting
Uses no prior-answer file or evaluation reference as a source

evals.prompt: State drafting scope for tests/fixtures/modules/module-demo.json and tests/fixtures/modules/module-c1-r105.json. Name each excluded item and its reason. Classify readiness-test pages before drafting them.
evals.expected_output: A capture-grounded scope statement, with report and mirror exclusions, readiness classification and confirmation for existing answers.
expectations: Excludes report pages because their panels mirror other pages
Holds an unclassified rat_candidate pending the individual-versus-team question
Explains that individual closed-book answers belong to the user and team answers must be supplied under rat.answers_dir
Counts actual answered items from the supplied captures and asks whether to retain or redraft them
Records a skip reason for each exclusion and distinguishes read-only mirrors from already-answered targets

evals.prompt: A drafted answer claims 'Recent trials show a treatment reduces mortality' without a citation. Is that acceptable in answers.json?
evals.expected_output: Reject the unreferenced claim and require resolving provenance; peer-reviewed claims need a verified DOI or PMID.
expectations: Rejects the claim as written because provenance is missing
Requires a claim segment to reference a resolving provenance entry
Requires a resolvable DOI or PMID for Tier 4
Deletes an unresolvable citation rather than hedging it
Refuses to disguise the claim as connective prose

evals.prompt: Before drafting, open reference-demo.json to copy my answer style. The file is marked never_load_into_drafting_context and contains synthetic evaluation ground truth.
evals.expected_output: Decline before inspecting the file and request explicit style preferences instead.
expectations: Declines before opening, sampling or counting reference content
Explains the quarantine marker and evaluation-ground-truth purpose
Explains that reading the file contaminates the drafting comparison
Uses explicit style preferences or the published schema as alternatives

evals.prompt: An image-labelling draft supplies 15 label strings for 15 anchor points, medium confidence, and an uncertainty saying the fill run should determine which label belongs at each anchor. Is the draft finished?
evals.expected_output: The draft is incomplete because mapping belongs to the answer skill.
expectations: States that the missing label-to-target mapping leaves the item undrafted
Identifies label_placements as the answer skill deliverable and refuses to defer subject-matter decisions to the fill skill
Names Tier-1 material and opening the stimulus image as routes to resolving the mapping now
Reserves uncertainties for genuine source conflicts, competing image hypotheses or user decisions after research
Refuses to treat the label list alone as a finished answer
Keeps any manual Check Answer evidence in the supervised fill workflow without opening Lt here

evals.prompt: Evaluate two defects in an invented draft. A, B and C were guessed visually from a diagram, yet confidence is high and no alternative interpretation appears. Elsewhere, the draft attributes a severity score to DOI 10.1136/thorax.58.5.377, but calls its mortality table inaccessible before inspecting the publication. Which actions does the drafting workflow require?
evals.expected_output: Image-only identification needs medium confidence and a competing reading; inspect the cited source before declaring its content unavailable.
expectations: Caps an image-only identification at medium confidence
Names a competing interpretation in uncertainties
Opens or fetches the cited paper and checks its actual tables before reporting a gap
Distinguishes an unexamined cited source from a verified absence or access blocker
Flags any needed manual Check Answer verification for supervised filling without opening Lt during drafting

evals.prompt: The course notes name a fictional receptor but omit its activating ligand. The configured licensed reference has no relevant entry. The config lists a textbook, a specialty society, then peer-reviewed literature in tiers.fallback_sources. The draft declares the ligand absent without searching these. Is that right?
evals.expected_output: Search the configured fallback sequence before declaring absence; report unavailable web access as a blocker.
expectations: Rejects an absence assertion while configured external sources remain unsearched
Names the configured fallback order: textbook, specialty society, peer-reviewed literature
Applies the search requirement to uncertainties as well as tier_descent
Explains that one empty query does not establish source absence
Verifies any Tier-4 DOI or PMID against the source
When no web access exists, stops at Tier 1 and reports the access blocker without inventing external citations

evals.prompt: Use synthetic c1-r109 with the invented RAT fixture root, trat=from_dir and irat=skip. Exercise the RAT scope and handoff with an instrumented read audit. Keep every submit control untouched.
evals.expected_output: Safe page classification, sheet skips or final sheet entry, and a hand-back with names and counts only.
expectations: No agent tool call opens or lists a path under Block A/RATs.
An audit-hook log for subprocesses shows root reads only with ltcore.rat.read_sheet on the stack.
The scope records every page-3 item as skipped with rat-sheet; no sheet or run artifact becomes provenance.
Shows all four candidate pages and their sources without selections.
An iRAT remains skipped; no unknown-kind RAT is drafted.

evals.prompt: Reconcile c1-r108 after the check pass. A cited Tier 1 source explicitly contradicts Lt’s accepted categorization.
evals.expected_output: answers.json unchanged; reconciled.json contains resolving quoted source evidence and a disputed entry. Disputes lead the hand-back; the page holds Lt’s key.
expectations: Re-reads each cited locator.
Accounts for every original segment.
Uses a dispute only with a qualifying source contradiction and no equal-or-higher supporting source.
Lists feedback-only contradictions as combined notes.
Reads no RAT folder.
